author: Ruohang Feng (rh@vonng.com)
description: Detailed telemetry for one RustFS instance, including MinIO-family readiness, process load, S3/HTTP activity, storage, internode RPC, TLS, alerts, and logs.

panels.description: Pigsty node identity and RustFS readiness. RustFS is a MinIO flavor and uses the MinIO monitoring identity.
RustFS cluster members with stable Pigsty identity, OTEL version, independent readiness, telemetry freshness, and process load.
panels.title: RustFS Cluster Members

panels.description: Independent HTTPS readiness probe.
RustFS internal runtime readiness gauge.
Seconds since the latest pushed OTLP sample.
RustFS process uptime.
RustFS process CPU percent as reported by the runtime sampler.
RustFS process memory footprint.
Open file descriptors divided by the configured limit.
Requests currently being served by the HTTP transport.
S3 operation rate and total HTTP request rate for this RustFS process.
panels.title: Instance Load

panels.description: Active RustFS alerts. Click to open Pigsty Alertmanager.
Pigsty alert timeline: solid bands are firing alerts and pale bands are pending alerts. Click a series to inspect or silence it in Alertmanager.
panels.title: RustFS Alerts

panels.description: CPU percent from RustFS' process and system samplers.
panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Process RSS, virtual memory, and RustFS memory sampler.
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: Process file descriptor usage.
panels.title: File Descriptors

panels.description: Process read/write bytes per second. These counters describe process I/O, not S3 payload traffic.
panels.title: Process I/O

panels.description: All HTTP handled by this process, including S3, admin, health, and internode HTTP.
panels.title: Request Rate

panels.description: Client and server error responses by status class.
panels.title: Failure Rate

panels.description: Exact average latency from histogram sum/count. Generic beta11 buckets are too coarse for useful sub-second p95/p99.
panels.title: Average Latency

panels.description: Request and response body throughput through this HTTP server.
panels.title: Body Throughput

panels.description: One-hot runtime state for every drive as observed by this node.
panels.title: Drive Runtime State

panels.description: Free space ratio for every drive observed by this node.
panels.title: Drive Free Ratio

panels.description: Age of the last drive capacity observation. Growth indicates stale drive telemetry.
panels.title: Capacity Observation Age

panels.description: Incoming and outgoing internode operation rate.
panels.title: Operation Rate

panels.description: Internode payload bytes by operation and direction.
panels.title: Payload Throughput

panels.description: Exact average internode operation latency from histogram sum/count.
panels.title: Average Operation Latency

panels.description: Internode operation and dial errors.
panels.title: Internode Errors

panels.description: Current scanner activity and throughput.
panels.title: Scanner Activity

panels.description: Scanner failure counters over the selected rate interval.
panels.title: Scanner Failures

panels.description: Allocator reserved, committed, and requested bytes.
panels.title: Memory Allocator

panels.description: TLS runtime generation, trust roots, mTLS identity, and handshake failures.
panels.title: TLS Runtime

targets.expr: job:syslog ip:$ip app:rustfs | unpack_json | stats by (level) count() as count
